Plot surrogate model region assignments on the biplot

plot.bl_surrogate.Rd

Renders the prediction surface background (coloured squares, clipped to the training-data convex hull), overlays observation points coloured by their surrogate region assignment, and draws the hull-clipped surrogate contour lines. No background colour is shown outside the hull.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bl_surrogate'
plot(
  x,
  cex_z = 0.7,
  label_dir = "Paral",
  label_cex = 1,
  tick_label_cex = 0.6,
  ticks_v = 1L,
  ticks_var = 0L,
  ticks_n = 5L,
  which = NULL,
  X_names = NULL,
  label_offset_var = 0L,
  label_offset_dist = 1.5,
  rotate_deg = 0,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A "bl_surrogate" object from bl_surrogate().

cex_z

Numeric; size of observation points. Default 0.7.

label_dir

Character; biplotEZ axis label direction. "Paral" (default) follows the plot border – left/right are vertical, top/bottom are horizontal. "Hor" forces horizontal. "Orthog" draws labels perpendicular to the axis.

label_cex

Numeric; variable name (axis label) size. Default 1.

tick_label_cex

Numeric; axis tick label size. Default 0.6.

ticks_v

Integer; number of ticks per variable axis. Default 1L.

ticks_var

Integer, integer vector, character, or character vector; variable(s) whose tick-mark count should override ticks_v. Supply variable names (e.g. "Sepal.Length") or integer indices (e.g. c(1L, 3L)). 0 (default) means no override – every axis uses ticks_v.

ticks_n

Integer or integer vector; tick-mark count(s) for the variable(s) named in ticks_var. A single value applies to all listed variables; a vector must match the length of ticks_var. Default 5L.

which

Integer vector; indices of variables to draw axes for. Defaults to all variables.

X_names

Character vector; custom variable names for axis labels. Defaults to bl_result$var_names.

label_offset_var

Integer, integer vector, character, or character vector; variable(s) whose axis labels should be shifted outward. Supply variable names or integer indices. 0 (default) means no offset.

label_offset_dist

Numeric or numeric vector; outward offset distance(s) in margin lines. Useful range 1–3. Default 1.5.

rotate_deg

Numeric; clockwise rotation in degrees for the entire plot. Default 0 (no rotation).

...

Unused; for S3 compatibility.

Details

The rendering order mirrors plot_biplotEZ():

  1. biplotEZ axis skeleton (axes only, no sample points).

  2. Hull-clipped prediction grid (blue-white-red squares, inside hull only).

  3. Surrogate-coloured observation points (red = class 1, blue = class 0).

  4. Axes redrawn on top so labels remain visible over the grid.

  5. Hull-clipped surrogate contour lines in black.
